g.text: Two AL8860 constant-current buck channels from a 24 V adapter. 333 mA per channel (0.1 V / 0.30 ohm).

g.desc: Two AL8860 constant-current buck channels from a 24 V adapter. 333 mA per channel (0.1 V / 0.30 ohm).

g.text: Each channel drives one off-board string of 4 LEDs on a star heatsink: blue 450 nm on J3, red 660 nm on J4.

g.desc: Each channel drives one off-board string of 4 LEDs on a star heatsink: blue 450 nm on J3, red 660 nm on J4.

g.text: J2 takes the sensor node's PWM (3.3 V logic, 250 Hz). CTRL above 2.5 V = full current, below 0.2 V = off;

g.desc: J2 takes the sensor node's PWM (3.3 V logic, 250 Hz). CTRL above 2.5 V = full current, below 0.2 V = off;

g.text: the 1.5k pull-downs keep the LEDs off when J2 is unplugged or the node is in reset.

g.desc: the 1.5k pull-downs keep the LEDs off when J2 is unplugged or the node is in reset.

g.text: J1: centre-positive 24 V barrel jack. F1 + D1 protect against overload and a reversed adapter.

g.desc: J1: centre-positive 24 V barrel jack. F1 + D1 protect against overload and a reversed adapter.
